answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks, an AI economy can employ the "Juniper Protocol", which leverages a distributed, decentralized mirror network to verify agent identities. By mapping each agent's signature to a unique, randomly generated nebula node, the network can detect duplicate identities. Agents must provide a juniper-encrypted, one-time password to register, and subsequent transactions require a verification process that checks the agent's signature against the nebula node, effectively rendering Sybil attacks costly and impractical.
